rewrites.//: go_router uses real paths (/login, /erp/courses). Without this, refreshing on any page other than / asks Firebase for a file that doesn't exist and 404s. Every path falls through to index.html and Flutter routes it client-side.

headers.//: Hashed/versioned assets never change content under the same name, so cache them hard. This matters more than usual here: the wasm renderer is several MB, and re-downloading it per visit is what burns Firebase's 360MB/day free transfer.
index.html must NOT be cached, or returning users keep booting an old build that points at asset hashes which no longer exist.
